name: esim-for-u
description: Travel mobile data with eSIM For U: find destinations, see current data plans, estimate how much data a trip needs, check eSIM support on a phone and get step-by-step install help.

interface.longDescription:
eSIM For U helps travellers get mobile data abroad without a local SIM card.

Ask about a destination and the plugin shows the data plans that are currently available there, with data amount, validity and the price shown on esimforu.app. It can estimate how much data a trip needs from the number of days and how the phone is used, check whether a phone model supports eSIM, and walk through installing and turning on an eSIM on iPhone and Android.

Plans are data-only: no phone number, no calls and no SMS. Prices and availability come live from esimforu.app and can change. Each answer links to the destination page on esimforu.app for full details.
capabilities: Find eSIM destinations by country or region
Show current data plans for a destination
Estimate data needed for a trip
Check whether a phone supports eSIM
Explain eSIM installation on iPhone and Android
defaultPrompt: I'm going to Thailand for 10 days. Which eSIM data plans are there?
How much mobile data do I need for two weeks in Japan with maps and social media?
Does my iPhone 12 support eSIM, and how do I install one?

positive.description: Find data plans for a country trip
positive.prompt: I'm flying to Türkiye next week for 8 days. What eSIM data plans can I get?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows current Türkiye plans (data amount, validity, price as listed on esimforu.app) and links to https://esimforu.app/esim/tr for details. No checkout link.

positive.prompt: Is there an eSIM for the Maldives?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Maldives (and any region that covers it) and says plans are available, with a link to the destination page.

positive.prompt: How much data do I need for 14 days in Japan if I use maps, WhatsApp and Instagram every day?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a GB estimate with the assumptions per activity and a suggested plan size.

positive.prompt: Does a Samsung Galaxy S21 support eSIM?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers whether the model supports eSIM, with any regional caveats and how to check on the phone.

positive.prompt: I bought an eSIM. How do I install and turn it on for data on my iPhone?
positive.expected_behavior: Step-by-step iPhone instructions: install, set as data line, turn on data roaming for the eSIM, and when to do it.

negative.description: Unrelated request: no tool should run
negative.prompt: Write me a poem about autumn in Vienna.

negative.description: Phone number / SMS request: the plans are data-only, the plugin should not claim to provide a number
negative.prompt: I need a phone number to receive SMS verification codes in Germany.

negative.description: Home mobile contract question outside the plugin's scope
negative.prompt: Can you cancel my Vodafone contract and port my number to another carrier?

publication.release_notes: First release: destination search, current data plans, data estimate, phone eSIM check and install help.
